sources.vulnerabilities: OSV.dev — proxied via Debian, Ubuntu, Alpine

limitations: Arch is not an OSV ecosystem. CVEs are discovered via OSV queries against Debian / Ubuntu / Alpine using Arch package names, then filtered locally by comparing Arch's upstream version to the fixed version in each OSV record. Records with no explicit fixed version are dropped (unverifiable). False negatives possible when Arch packages are renamed vs. upstream distros; false positives possible when Arch backports a patch without a version bump.
